title: 67 Plugin
description: This adds commands that we know every player has been asking for since 2025.
body:
# 67 Plugin
Made by [Sebminecrafter](https://github.com/sebminecrafter)\
This plugin adds the `/67`, `/89`, and `/41` commands to your server, which will send a message back to the player with the number `67` (or `89`/`41` respectively) along with whatever they type afterwards. This functions as a kind of test command to make sure that you're connected, but is mainly more of a joke or fun command.
![GIF showing use of the command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/291448671f1388acf2cd59455fe60b6feca7e931.gif)
## Installation Guide
This plugin is designed for [Bukkit](https://getbukkit.org), [Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org), or [Paper](https://papermc.io)\
You can install this plugin by downloading the latest version and adding it to the `plugins` folder.\
The commands should then be available to all players.
